question.text: For hydrogen atom, energy of an electron in first excited state is \(-3.4 \mathrm{eV}, \mathrm{K} . \mathrm{E}\). of the same electron of hydrogen atom is \(x \mathrm{eV}\). Value of \(x\) is ______ \(\times 10^{-1} \mathrm{eV}\). (Nearest integer)

solution.text:
Kinetic energy of electron is, 
$\mathrm{KE}=\frac{13 \cdot 6 \mathrm{Z}^2}{\mathrm{n}^2} \mathrm{eV}$ 
For the first excited state of the hydrogen atom, 
$\mathrm{n}=2$ and $\mathrm{Z}=1$ $\therefore \mathrm{KE}=\frac{13.6}{2^2}=3.4 \mathrm{eV}$
